brief.intent: A production transparent Rambelle assistant cutout for the RambleDesk desktop application''s right-side status rail and empty states.
brief.audience: RambleDesk desktop users working through long feedback sessions.
brief.emotionalGoal: Quiet readiness and reassuring precision; the chief military secretary has organized the record and is waiting without interrupting.
brief.composition: One fully in-frame three-quarter character, facing slightly toward the document area, calm soft-resolve expression, one hand lightly raised in a presenting gesture and the other resting near the waist. Generous margin and clean silhouette for cropping into a narrow assistant card.
mustInclude: Latest Rambelle identity: long pure white hair, ice-blue eyes, pale futuristic chief military secretary uniform
New hollow-center hexagonal vault-door badge on the uniform
One single isolated character on pure #FF00FF matte
All hair, hands, and clothing fully visible
avoid: Old circular zero emblem or eye-like badge
Military salute, aggressive pose, oversized props
Text, letters, numbers, scenery, furniture, shadows
Cropping any body part or hair
creativeFreedom: Subtle head angle and soft-resolve expression

acceptanceCriteria: Transparent final PNG with clean edges
No text, scenery, old emblem, or cropped anatomy
notes: Approved downstream asset after Gate 1. Intended as an optional L2/L3 identity layer; never contains live UI or text.
